tools.name: search_linkedin_employees
tools.description: Find employees at a company on LinkedIn. Returns name, headline, location, and profile URL. Uses Google's index, so no LinkedIn login or cookies are needed.

tools.name: search_linkedin_posts
tools.description: Search LinkedIn posts by keyword. Returns post snippet, author name, headline, and profile URL. Uses Google's index, so no LinkedIn login is needed.

tools.name: find_b2b_leads
tools.description: Find B2B leads at target companies: LinkedIn profiles, job titles, and likely business emails. No API key needed.

tools.name: find_linkedin_candidates
tools.description: Recruiter sourcing: find LinkedIn profiles matching a role, skills, location, experience band, and optional target companies. Returns name, headline, current title and company, profile URL, matched skills, and a match-confidence score. No login needed.

tools.name: get_linkedin_profiles
tools.description: Fetch full LinkedIn profile details by profile URL: experience, education, skills, headline, and location. No login or cookies needed.

tools.name: get_linkedin_company
tools.description: Get LinkedIn company details: employee count, industry, website, follower count, headquarters, and description. Accepts LinkedIn company URLs, or plain company names (resolved best-effort to a linkedin.com/company slug).

tools.name: find_website_contacts
tools.description: Crawl a list of domains and extract business emails, phone numbers, and social profile links (LinkedIn, X, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube) from homepages, contact and about pages. No API key needed.

tools.name: verify_emails
tools.description: Bulk-verify email addresses: syntax, MX records, SMTP deliverability, disposable-domain and role-based detection. Use before sending outreach so you only contact addresses that exist.

tools.name: search_linkedin_jobs
tools.description: Search LinkedIn job listings by keyword and location. Returns job title, company, location, seniority, and applicant count. No login needed.

tools.name: scrape_ats_jobs
tools.description: Scrape job listings from company ATS boards: Greenhouse, Lever, Workday, and Ashby. Reads their public job APIs, so no login is needed.

tools.name: search_naukri_jobs
tools.description: Search Naukri.com for job listings in India. Returns job title, company, location, salary range, experience required, and description.

tools.name: scrape_reddit
tools.description: Scrape Reddit posts and comments by subreddit, keyword search, or post URL. Returns full post data with comment trees.

tools.name: search_google_trends
tools.description: Get Google Trends interest data for up to 5 keywords. Returns interest over time, geographic breakdown, and related queries.

tools.name: scrape_trustpilot
tools.description: Scrape Trustpilot reviews for any company. Returns reviewer name, star rating, review title, body, date, and verified status.

tools.name: search_google_maps
tools.description: Search Google Maps business listings by keyword and location. Returns name, category, address, phone, website, rating, review count, opening hours, and coordinates. No login, no Google Maps API key. Usually returns pending first; collect with get_run_results.

tools.name: search_sec_filings
tools.description: Full-text search across SEC EDGAR filings: 10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, and more. Returns filing metadata and matched text excerpts.

tools.name: lookup_lei
tools.description: Look up a company Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) in the official GLEIF registry by legal name. Returns LEI code, registration status, legal address, and entity status. The authoritative source for checking that a company legally exists.

tools.name: resolve_company_identity
tools.description: Resolve a company name to its identifiers across registries in one call: GLEIF LEI, legal name, country, entity status, and SEC EDGAR CIK plus last filing date. Use to ground company facts before trusting them.

tools.name: analyze_github_repos
tools.description: Metadata for public GitHub repositories: stars, forks, language breakdown, topics, license, README content, contributor count, latest release, and commit recency. Use to see what a company or project is building. No GitHub token needed.

tools.name: search_indiamart_suppliers
tools.description: Search IndiaMART for B2B suppliers and manufacturers in India. Returns company name, products, location, contact details, and ratings.

tools.name: search_sam_gov_contracts
tools.description: Search live US federal contract opportunities on SAM.gov: solicitations, presolicitations, sources-sought, and award notices. Filter by keyword, NAICS code, notice type, agency, and set-aside type. Needs your own free SAM.gov / api.data.gov API key.

tools.name: search_fec_campaign_finance
tools.description: Search US federal campaign finance via the official OpenFEC API: candidates by name, committees and PACs by name, or itemized Schedule A contributions for one committee.

tools.name: search_companies_house_uk
tools.description: Search or look up UK companies on the official Companies House register: status, type, incorporation date, registered office address, SIC codes, and optionally the full officer roster. Needs your own free Companies House API key.

tools.name: search_pubmed
tools.description: Search PubMed for biomedical literature. Returns PMID, title, abstract, authors, journal, and DOI. 36M+ articles indexed.

tools.name: search_arxiv
tools.description: Search arXiv preprints by keyword or category. Returns title, abstract, authors, and PDF link. Best for AI, CS, physics, and biology research.

tools.name: search_nih_grants
tools.description: Search NIH RePORTER for grant awards by topic, agency, or institution. Returns project title, abstract, award amount, PI names, and institution.

tools.name: search_zillow
tools.description: Search Zillow for-sale or rental listings by city, ZIP, or neighborhood. Returns price, beds, baths, sqft, address, coordinates, and listing URL. No API key.

tools.name: get_zillow_property_details
tools.description: Fetch Zillow property data from listing URLs or ZPIDs: price history, tax history, school ratings, HOA fee, year built, Zestimate, rent Zestimate, and photos. Chains off search_zillow output.

tools.name: search_redfin
tools.description: Search Redfin for-sale or recently-sold listings by city, ZIP, or Redfin URL. Returns price, beds, baths, sqft, price per sqft, listing agent, broker, MLS ID, and listing URL. Use soldWithinDays for comparable-sales analysis.

tools.name: search_realtor
tools.description: Search Realtor.com for-sale or sold listings by city or ZIP. Returns price, beds, baths, sqft, county, listing status, and the listing agent and brokerage office for every record. No MLS login.

tools.name: get_run_results
tools.description: Collect the results of a previously started actor run. Use this when another tool returned status "pending" with a run_id: wait a few seconds, then call this with that run_id. Repeat until it returns results.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_linkedin_employees, search_linkedin_posts, get_linkedin_profiles, get_linkedin_company, find_website_contacts, scrape_reddit, scrape_trustpilot, search_google_maps, search_zillow, get_zillow_property_details, search_redfin · Private data: find_b2b_leads, find_website_contacts, verify_emails, search_google_maps, analyze_github_repos, search_indiamart_suppliers, search_sam_gov_contracts, search_companies_house_uk, search_zillow, search_realtor · Public sink: search_linkedin_posts, verify_emails, scrape_reddit · Destructive: get_run_results.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_linkedin_employees, search_linkedin_posts, get_linkedin_profiles, get_linkedin_company, find_website_contacts, scrape_reddit, scrape_trustpilot, search_google_maps, search_zillow, get_zillow_property_details, search_redfin · Private data: find_b2b_leads, find_website_contacts, verify_emails, search_google_maps, analyze_github_repos, search_indiamart_suppliers, search_sam_gov_contracts, search_companies_house_uk, search_zillow, search_realtor · Public sink: search_linkedin_posts, verify_emails, scrape_reddit · Destructive: get_run_results

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
